name: What types of materials are commonly used for door casing?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are commonly used for door casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for door casing include various wood species like pine, oak, and poplar, offering different grains and finishes. MDF (medium-density fiberboard) is another popular choice, known for its smooth finish and affordability, especially when painting is desired. For high-moisture areas or specific aesthetic needs, PVC or composite materials can also be used. Each material offers distinct benefits regarding durability, appearance, and cost, which is a practical tradeoff to consider for your home's specific environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common casing materials are wood (pine, oak, poplar) for natural looks and MDF for smooth, paintable, affordable options; PVC for moisture resistance.
